scenario: The twin of LNUL.4.10.null_beside_a_trap_is_the_trap, and the half that carries the content: were `null + <trap>` the `null` of [LNUL.4.1], `?? 7` would rescue it and the rule would fire. [LNUL.4.10] makes it the fault, which `??` does not rescue ([LNUL.5.3]), so neither rule fires. Both sides of `+`. `type_error` and `engine_error` are forbidden: every operand is well-typed and the engine stays intact. Path: the non-connective BINOP arm under a `??` — libds rete/eval.c (BINOP, then COALESCE's latch-before-kind test), Mercury ds.eval.m eval_node(e_binop(...)) under eval_node(e_coalesce(...)).
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    n: Int? mutable
    a: Int mutable
    z: Int mutable

rule null_left:
    S s where ((s.n + s.a // s.z) ?? 7) == 7
->
    log info "left rescued"

rule null_right:
    S s where ((s.a // s.z + s.n) ?? 7) == 7
->
    log info "right rescued"
